# Ground-truth compiler identity, captured verbatim. SKILL.md requires verifying
# that dxc reports the expected commit before trusting any result; this is that
# verification, recorded rather than merely performed.

$ <repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe --version
dxcompiler.dll: 1.10(5422-eff900d5)(1.9.0.15422) - 1.9.0.15422 (main, eff900d54)
[exit] 0

Expected per the triage brief: 1.9.0.15422 (main, eff900d54)   -- MATCHES.

Binary identity (so a stranger can tell whether they have the same build):
  dxc.exe          7296000 bytes, mtime 2026-08-05 21:21:41Z
  dxcompiler.dll   75968000 bytes, mtime 2026-08-05 21:21:37Z
  sha256 dxcompiler.dll  0E2DF92C53B31B679128FA5BD050BBE0D6B74827425BAE1B75C267384E3E571D

Corroboration: the same string appears in DXIL emitted by this binary and captured
by triage.py run -- see variant-odr-used-main-debug.txt line 87:
  !0 = !{!"dxc(private) 1.9.0.15422 (main, eff900d54)"}
so the identity is attested by the tool-captured evidence too, not only by this file.

Note: build/Release/bin/dxc.exe also exists in this tree but is a DIFFERENT, dirty,
